product_matrix.expected_host_behavior: Host reaches a coherent idle Companion state and can exercise every first GATT surface without hardware.
product_matrix.scenario: Scan, read status, write a card, list recordings, pull one recording, pull logs, and read OTA status in one fixture session.

product_matrix.expected_host_behavior: Retry resumes by byte offset instead of duplicating already verified recording bytes.
product_matrix.scenario: Retry after a timeout or busy response rereads status and repeats the idempotent operation once.

product_matrix.expected_host_behavior: User sees transfer canceled and can retry; no delete-after-sync is sent.
product_matrix.scenario: A transfer cancel stops the active pull and leaves the recording available for a later byte-offset resume.

product_matrix.expected_host_behavior: Host recovers through scan/connect and does not trust stale packet sequence without total_length continuity.
product_matrix.scenario: Disconnect after partial recording pull, reconnect, reread recording_list, and resume from the next byte offset.

product_matrix.expected_host_behavior: Host resumes by byte_offset and total_length, not by stale packet sequence or local UI state.
product_matrix.scenario: BLE link drops after 8192 verified bytes; host reconnects, rereads recording_list, and requests the next absolute byte offset.

product_matrix.expected_host_behavior: Classify gatt_cache_stale, refresh service discovery once, then suggest re-pair and diagnostic export if it repeats.
product_matrix.scenario: Host sees Companion service changed/stale GATT cache symptoms after reconnect before any firmware data transfer.

product_matrix.expected_host_behavior: Classify cccd_notify_failure, reopen notify subscription once, and keep delete-after-sync disabled until host verification.
product_matrix.scenario: Notify subscription cannot enable CCCD for recording or diagnostic packets.

product_matrix.expected_host_behavior: Only the first reconnected event may be user-visible; repeated recovered_event_suppressed entries stay diagnostic-only.
product_matrix.scenario: Repeated automatic BLE recovery succeeds several times during one sync session.

product_matrix.expected_host_behavior: Host treats total_length and final SHA-256 as authoritative before delete-after-sync.
product_matrix.scenario: Host validates long recording metadata before transfer: 160000 bytes, sample format, CRC/hash, and created time/tick.

product_matrix.expected_host_behavior: Stale local UI state is refreshed or an actionable timeout is surfaced.
product_matrix.scenario: After idle, host rereads status and recording_list before offering a sync action.

product_matrix.expected_host_behavior: Support package includes cursor, event count, and CRC without attempting an unbounded full dump.
product_matrix.scenario: Host requests a bounded diagnostic tail after an error or blocked transfer.

product_matrix.expected_host_behavior: Host shows blocker names and does not offer OTA transfer writes.
product_matrix.scenario: OTA readiness is not ready while low battery, transfer, diag export, wrong-board, invalid-hash, or interrupted-transfer blockers are present.
